summary: Iter 28 — Ride Stronger Phase 2 expansion (8 weeks / 2 phases / 24 rides) PASS + Couch-to-Road regression PASS. Backend 3/3 pytest in test_ride_stronger.py: (1) GET /api/plans returns ride-stronger with type=structured and week_count/duration_weeks == 8 (was 4). (2) POST /api/rider/plan {plan_id:'ride-stronger', reset_progress:true} then GET /api/plan returns id='ride-stronger', duration_weeks=8, current_week=1, progress.weeks='1 / 8', phases = [{number:1,name:'Foundation and Control',active:true,weeks:'Weeks 1–4'},{number:2,name:'Strength and Sustainable Power',active:false,weeks:'Weeks 5–8'}], workouts still shows Week 1 rides (rs-ride-1,2,3). (3) Regression: reassigning couch-to-road still returns duration_weeks=16 with ctr-ride-1/2/3 present. Frontend (mobile 390x844) verified via Playwright: logged in as Green Lantern, assigned ride-stronger via /api/rider/plan and confirmed GET /api/plan returned the 2-phase 8-week structure above (assign_status:200, phases[0].active=true, phases[1].active=false). Navigated to /training?workoutId=rs-ride-19 — page rendered 'Controlled Threshold Development' with Threshold Development 1, 2 and 3 in the interval timeline plus Settle In / Warm-Up Build. /training?workoutId=rs-ride-16 rendered 'Seated Climbing Strength' with Seated Climb 1, 2, 3 and 4 in the timeline. /workout?workoutId=rs-ride-19 and rs-ride-16 both opened Live Workout HUD successfully — coach cue was 'you are pushing 235 watts, nearly 80 over target' proving the authored interval targets are wired end-to-end for Phase 2. This confirms rs-ride-13..24 resolve in the frontend workout catalog. Finally re-assigned couch-to-road; GET /api/plan returned id='couch-to-road', duration_weeks=16, current_week=1 — Green Lantern is left on couch-to-road as required.
